'''Gerhard Dietrich''' (26 November 1927 &ndash; 8 October 1986) was a leading [[East Germany|German]] [[Pedagogy|pedagogue]] and a [[Trades Union]] official.<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD>{{cite web|url=http://www.bundesstiftung-aufarbeitung.de/wer-war-wer-in-der-ddr-%2363%3B-1424.html?ID=582|author1=[[Helmut Müller-Enbergs]]|title=Dietrich, Gerhard * 26.11.1927, † 8.10.1986 Generalsekretär der Akademie der Pädagogischen Wissenschaften|publisher= Bundesstiftung zur Aufarbeitung der SED-Diktatur: Biographische Datenbanken|accessdate= 18 November 2014}}</ref>

From 1952 to 1980 he worked at what was then the [[Leipzig University|Karl Marx University]] of [[Leipzig]] on the [[:de:Methodik|Structuring]] and [[Methodology]] of teaching [[Biology]].   Between 1980 and 1986 he was General Secretary of the [[East Berlin|Berlin]] based [[:de:Akademie der Pädagogischen Wissenschaften der DDR|Academy of Pedagogic Sciences]].

==Life==

===Early years===
Gerhard Dietrich was born on 26 November, 1927. The son of a metal worker, Dietrich attended school locally at [[:de:Hundshübel|Hundshübel]] on the north side of the [[Ore Mountains]] that divide [[Saxony]] from [[Bohemia]].   Between 1942 and 1944 he attended the commerce focused [[:de:Handelsschule|High school]] at nearby [[Eibenstock]], training for a career as a [[baker]].<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>   He was a member of the [[Hitler Youth]] between 1941 and 1945.<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>   Dietrich was sent to perform military service in 1944/45 and spent the period May–December 1945 in an Allied internment camp (Camp 2228) in the [[Rhineland]].<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>

===Career===
In 1945–46 Dietrich was employed at a factory in [[Stützengrün]] that made brushes. In 1946 he joined the [[Communist Party of Germany|KPD (Communist party)]]. However, the [[Soviet occupation zone|part of Germany]] in which he lived was in the process of being transformed into the [[German Democratic Republic|German Democratic Republic (East Germany)]], a new state  created under a nation-building project that had been prepared in some detail by [[Ulbricht Group|a team]] that had arrived from [[Moscow]] in April–May 1945. The plans did not envisage a genuine [[multi-party system|multi-party political system]], and by the end of 1946 Gerhard Dietrich was [[Merger of the KPD and SPD into the Socialist Unity Party of Germany|a member of]] the country's ruling [[Socialist Unity Party of Germany|SED (Socialist Unity Party of Germany / ''Sozialistische Einheitspartei Deutschlands'')]].<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>

There was an acute shortage of working-age people in Germany by 1945, and from 1946 till 1949 Dietrich, like many others, worked as a [[:de:Neulehrer|pre-qualified trainee teacher]] at a junior school.  He worked during these years in [[:de:Hundshübel|Hundshübel]], after which he became a full teacher, working at the middle school, now becoming involved in [[Teacher education|teacher training]]. In 1949 he took a teaching job at the senior school in [[Schneeberg, Saxony|Schneeberg]].<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>

Later in 1949 he moved to the [[Leipzig University|Karl Marx University]] in [[Leipzig]] where for three years, till 1952, he was a student at the [[Pedagogy]] faculty.  He then stayed on, between 1952 and 1956, as a research assistant.   He then, still at Leipzig, took a lectureship, remaining in post till 1963.  During this period he received a [[doctorate]] in Pedagogy in 1957 and [[Habilitation|further promotion]] in 1962. A professorship incorporating a teaching contract followed in 1963.<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>   From 1964 till 1969, still at [[Leipzig University|Leipzig]] Gerhard Dietrich was ''Prorektor für wissenschaftlichen Nachwuchs'' ("vice-rector for young scientists") which was followed by a period from 1970 till 1976 as Director of the Pedagogy Section and head of the Teaching Methodology department.<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>

From 1977 till 1980 Dietrich was chairman of the ''Arbeitsgemeinschaft Pädagogische Wissenschaft'' ("Association of Educational Science") and ''[[ordentlicher Professor]]'' for the Methodology of Biology Teaching.  He was also chairman of the ''Zentrale Fachkommission Biologiemethodik des Ministeriums für Volksbildung und des Ministeriums für Hoch- und Fachschulwesen der DDR'' ("Central Commission on Biology Methodology of the Ministries of Peoples' Education and of Higher Education and Specialist Training in the German Democratic Republic"). On top of this, since 1970 Dietrich had been a member of the national Academy of Pedagogical Sciences (APW), and from 1980 until his death in 1986 he served as General Secretary of this institution.<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>  Finally, between 1980 and 1986 he was a member of the Central Executive Committee of the Education and Training Trades Union.<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>

==Publications==
*  Die Sicherung der Lernergebnisse im Biologieunterricht; Berlin 1962<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/> 
*  Methodik Biologieunterricht; Berlin 1976<ref name=BiographischeDatenbankenGD/>
* (with Friedrich W. Stöcker) Fachlexikon ABC Biologie : ein alphabetisches Nachschlagewerk für Wissenschaftler und Naturfreunde: H. Deutsch, 1986 
* (with Annelies Müller-Hegemann) Jugendlexikon Biologie; Bibliographisches Institut, 1987
